text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Pooled difference in quantile score with a 95% interval from resampling months (98.75% for the leave-one-out rows). Below zero favours all history. C1, which has no drift term, changes sign with the substation left out and with the season.'
text.tspan: Pooled difference in quantile score with a 95% interval from resampling months (98.75% for the
leave-one-out rows). Below zero favours all history. C1, which has no drift term, changes sign
with the substation left out and with the season.
